incidentalMention.review: The word is an ordinary instruction verb in an old caption about text compression, not a teaching example for the root alternation or a repeated pair.

posts.benefit: Spell four familiar digital terms correctly in correspondence.
decisions: Keshbek has E after K and Э after B; messenger contains D before Zh; marketplace is one word; aggregator has one G.

A candidate about postamat was rejected because a unique normative spelling for that intended word was not securely confirmed by the proofreader. Aggregator replaced it after a current RAN source check.

posts.benefit: Separate additive тоже from the demonstrative combination то же in four concrete phrases.
decisions: Do not assign every use of тоже one universal part-of-speech label.
The substitutions are semantic clues for these actual sentences, not a claim that any replacement by И proves joined spelling.

posts.benefit: Recognize condition in the first clause and consequence in the second in selected BSP examples.
decisions: The right head is Подсказка. If can precede the first clause, therefore can precede the second; the head does not tell the viewer to mechanically replace the dash.
Captions explicitly set the intended condition/consequence relationship and retain the need for complete context.

posts.benefit: Use meaning to distinguish в заключение/в заключении and в продолжение/в продолжении in adult documents.
decisions: The right head says Выбранный смысл.
The phrase в продолжение беседы is used here as continuing the conversation; captions note that a time meaning is also possible. No universal one-word translation is claimed.

posts.benefit: Select И before suffix -а- for three named alternating-root groups.
decisions: The final fourth pair is вытереть/вытирать. The initial стереть/стирать pair was also valid according to the full RAN paragraph; the replacement is an equivalent editorial choice, not correction of a factual error.
An incidental old caption contains убирать as an instruction about deleting details. It does not teach this root alternation; the overlap is retained in novelty evidence.

posts.benefit: See personification through speech, thought, facial expression and sleep assigned to nonliving nature.
decisions: The definition says traits/actions of living beings, not only humans.
All four phrases are our short educational images. The long term олицетворение is explained in the caption, while table labels remain short.
Not every predicate with a nature noun is called personification.
